UDPcast 20250223 Windows binaries

20250223/x64 and 20250223/a64 contain udp-sender.exe and udp-receiver.exe.
These were built from the a1ive/udpcast Windows port using LLVM-MinGW, with
the compatibility patch recorded alongside the exact source archive.
See 20250223/BUILD.txt for provenance, rebuild instructions and test limits.

Udpcast.targets includes both architectures in the main application and site
service output. The Imager includes only its NativeToolArchitecture (x64/a64).
Runtime paths: Tools/udpcast/{x64|a64}/udp-{sender|receiver}.exe.
Source, licenses, checksums and build instructions accompany the binaries.

This packaging does not enable multicast imaging or provide Linux binaries.
ARM64 execution and WinPE integration still require hardware validation.
